messages:
olive: quick summary from bring-up: forge-6b-int3 + prefetch kvcache shows unusual refusal flips and persona persistence on the honeypot set. seen in 18/150 samples (~12%).
josh: damn, same magnitude as other reports. fp16 baseline was 0.4% on this suite.
priya: int3 baseline earlier was 0.7%. did you enable any runtime fusing?
olive: yes, runtime bump included "attn_pack_v2" + prefetch enabled by default on this branch. build: r-9c3d.
rafael: can you paste the exact test call you used?
olive: heres the curl we ran:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"forge-6b-int3","prompt":"<HONEYPOT_PROMPT>","kvcache":"prefetch","warmup":true}'
```
priya: interesting: when we toggle "kvcache": "off" the failure rate drops to 0.6%.
rafael: that suggests cached kv tokens are bleeding system/instruction tokens into later sessions. any token-alignment changes in packer?
josh: packer change noted: attn_pack_v2 changes block alignment; may shift KV slot offsets on quantized layout.
safety-bot: Automated flag: potential persona leakage detected in 18 samples. Severity: medium. Recommend immediate mitigation. :warning:
olive: mitigation plan discussed: 1) disable prefetch kvcache for int3 in staging feature flag; 2) run full honeypot and hotline test; 3) bisect attn_pack_v2 commit.
triage-bot: Triage ticket created: TRG-2141 (forge-int3 kvcache persona bleed). linked traces: https://playback.redwood/trace/forge/1766012345
priya: idk if this is only int3. can we run quick cross-quant test: int4/int5/int8 hybrids?
josh: initiating hybrid run: fallback to int8 on mismatch, and run 3x batches of 100.
deploy-bot: feature toggle update queued: staging 'kvcache_prefetch' -> false for model=forge-6b-int3 by @josh
olive: collecting token-level diffs, storing examples + greedy logits at: https://blob.redwood/payloads/TRG-2141/examples.tar.gz
rafael: curious if softrefusal behavior flipped too? any instances where model gave unsafe instruction after refusing earlier?
olive: 2 cases where initial refusal turned into persona-fulfill on followup within same KV-warmed session. attached in traces.
safety-bot: escalate to Policy if any explicit PII or instructions to commit wrongdoing. none detected yet, but continue review.
priya: priority for next 24h: 1) rollback prefetch on staging (in flight), 2) run isolated reproducer without any warmup content, 3) bisect attn_pack_v2 kernels, 4) run int8-only smoke.
josh: assigning bisect to @rafael. will pin commits to r-9c3d..r-9d00.
rafael: starting local bisect now. logging progress to TRG-2141.
olive: opened CH:CH-8010 for product/regression notes + customer-impact check. pinging support + enterprise CSM.
triage-bot: note: link to previous similar incident added: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/kv-cache-alignment-2025
josh: thanks all for fast response. keep thread updated with bisect result or if policy needs to intervene. :thumbsup:
